''''Jade Hills'''' is a piece of [[furniture]] that hangs on a wall. It can be obtained only by donating 25 items to the [[Museum]].

If the original is lost, a replacement can be purchased at the [[Secret Woods#Lost Items Shop|Lost Items Shop]] in the Secret Woods for {{Price|10000}}.
